title: Hollywood locals react to Robert Pattinson being cast as new James Bond
html:
Robert Pattinson has been named the seventh James Bond, taking over from Daniel Craig in the next 007 film.

“To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement,” Pattinson said in a statement.

The BBC's Regan Morris finds out how fans and enthusiasts in Hollywood are reacting.
summary: The 40-year-old British actor will take over from Daniel Craig in the next 007 film as fans and enthusiasts react to the news.
